rationale: Read the retained receipt of experiment 9d28f043326440548185371b0d4f375a-experiment (CheckRun 7e6d5b3d49464a84ba43f7f9305ea5b6, exit 0, 22 events). The extended phase closes the child question: with an empty recovered configuration the node stored and applied an entry sent by a server outside its configuration (event 20, assertion violated), while the same run repeats the leadership admission and the election-gating control (event 21). The child account is updated to cite all four receipts and a behavior entry records the entries phase.

knowledge.statement: A node whose configuration is empty after a RestoreCommittedLogs restart stores and applies a command entry delivered by a server that appears in no configuration: the AppendEntries succeeded, the entry appeared in the node's log and the node's applied index advanced over it.
knowledge.conditions: RestoreCommittedLogs=true with a commit-tracking store; no snapshot, so the recovered configuration is empty; the sender is transport-reachable and its request carries one command entry with a leader commit index covering it.

interpretations.rationale: Current account: an empty recovered configuration removes participation checks on every path the question covers, while the node's own participation is gated off. Votes: event 7 of the two earlier receipts records Granted responses for a candidate absent from every configuration, with the requester's higher term adopted, while the live configuration is empty and the node's log still records the bootstrapped voter (event 6). Leadership: event 21 of the last receipt records an outsider's AppendEntries accepted with the outsider becoming the node's recorded leader; the identical observation appears at index 20 of the previous receipt. Entries: event 20 of the last receipt records the same outsider delivering one command entry - the AppendEntries succeeded, the entry is present in the node's log (last index 7 to 8) and the node's applied index advanced over it (6 to 8), which the declared assertion forbids. Gating: the control in the same runs holds - across six heartbeat timeouts the node stayed Follower and did not campaign. Mechanism from source: requestVote and requestPreVote apply their membership rejection only when their own Servers list is non-empty, and appendEntries applies no membership check at all, so once the configuration is empty any transport-reachable sender is admitted on votes and on log replication; quorumSize over an empty voter list is 1. Bounds: the condition requires RestoreCommittedLogs with a commit-tracking store and a restart whose recovered configuration is empty, and any later configuration entry (or installed snapshot) restores the configuration, which the parent question measures.
counterevidence: The empty-list leniency in the vote handlers is intentional for cluster bootstrap, and appendEntries has always trusted the sender's identity; what makes both harmful here is that the node's own recovery produces an empty configuration in a cluster that is not being bootstrapped.

The probe supplied the sender's identity and term rather than producing them through an election, so the requests are legal messages rather than a real campaign; a sender with a stale term is still rejected.
The node's own election gating is intact, so the failure is asymmetric: it admits others while suppressing itself, which also means it cannot repair the configuration by winning an election.
The window closes as soon as any configuration entry reaches the node, so the exposure is bounded by membership traffic or an installed snapshot.
limitations: Measured on in-memory single-node clusters with the repository's in-memory transport and commit-tracking store; production transports, authentication and network behaviour are not covered.
The entry phase used one command entry with no configuration semantics, so the FSM effect recorded is a single applied command.
The probe does not measure how long the empty configuration persists in a cluster without membership traffic; that follows from the repair path rather than from a timed observation.
interpretations.joint_history: Four receipts of the same harness file answer this question from one recovery state (an empty configuration after a RestoreCommittedLogs restart): two runs state the vote and pre-vote admission (f418b9d6ab8841faa9ab6c35ce1fcd75 and e1ee764584564a95b3e288381dfb75d9 at indices 6 and 7), one states the leadership acceptance and the election-gating control (e87ee87274544b3ba836dffb93a7ecb1 at indices 19 and 20), and the last states the entry path as well (7e6d5b3d49464a84ba43f7f9305ea5b6 at indices 19, 20 and 21). All four are distinct runs of the same file.
